original_test_intent: Measure inter-device read/write bandwidth over intended AMD xGMI links and verify every approved GPU pair against the applicable AMD specification without driver/link regressions.
original_method: Record GPU BDF/index/model, firmware/driver/ROCm/tool versions, xGMI topology/link state and clock/power/thermal baseline; approve product-compatible ROCm and pair/direction/size/repeat profile; run complete rocm-bandwidth-test across selected directed pairs; preserve raw matrix/output and telemetry; collect final topology/errors/logs, restore power settings and compare each pair to link-specific tolerances.
manual_activity: GPU owner approves ROCm/tool, topology/pairs/profile and link-specific thresholds; agent may inventory and execute after approval.
required_inputs: GPU model/BDF/index mapping, xGMI topology/link/rate and firmware/driver state
Directed GPU pairs, read/write/copy sizes, iterations/repetitions and aggregation
AMD topology/link-specific bandwidth thresholds/tolerances and error-counter policy
Isolation, clock/power/thermal abort and driver/reboot recovery/cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Do not upgrade to latest ROCm without recipe approval
Verify every selected pair maps to intended xGMI edge
Monitor temperature/power/clocks, utilization, link and driver errors
Stop on wrong pair, missing/degraded link, reset, error storm or limit
No automatic retry; preserve failing pair evidence and use approved recovery
agent_execution_scope: Run approved pairs and preserve complete raw output/telemetry
Collect final topology/logs and restore profile
Do not choose/upgrade ROCm, infer pairs/spec, change topology, rerun or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve ROCm/tool and GPU pair/topology scope
Define per-link bandwidth/error thresholds and repeat profile

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets AMD inter-device bandwidth via ROCm. 'Latest' and unspecified pairs/spec are unsafe gaps but not contradictory test intent.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Performance row39 Wistron-Performance GPU-00055-V004: approve product-compatible ROCm and rocm-bandwidth-test version/hash, exact GPU BDF/index topology and directed xGMI pairs, transfer/read-write profile and repetitions; provide direct/indirect link-specific bandwidth tolerances, link/error-counter rules, clock/power/thermal abort limits and driver/reboot cleanup/recovery policy.

review_improvement: Replaces a filtered unpinned run with a topology-attributable directed bandwidth matrix and per-pair health evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Device indices alone can change across boots and pair bandwidth depends on whether traffic follows a direct xGMI edge, an indirect route or PCIe fallback. Direction and transfer size can be asymmetric. Full topology/BDF mapping and raw matrix output are necessary to distinguish a valid link result from wrong-path throughput or a run with resets/errors.
